q: ___ life in big cities can be stressful.
She works as ___ engineer.
e: Jobs take a/an; 'engineer' begins with a vowel sound.

q: ___ government should invest more in ___ education.
e: 'The government' (we know which one); education in general has no article.

q: I bought a phone and a laptop. ___ laptop was very expensive.
e: Second mention: now we know which laptop.

q: She wants to study at ___ university abroad.
___ Amazon is ___ longest river in South America.
Most people agree that ___ health is more important than ___ money.
e: Abstract and uncountable nouns in general: no article.

q: She is ___ honest person. (a, an, the or –)
___ unemployment is a serious problem in many countries. (a, an, the or –)
e: Uncountable noun in general: no article.

q: It was ___ best holiday of my life. (a, an, the or –)
My brother is ___ doctor in a public hospital. (a, an, the or –)
___ sun rises in the east. (a, an, the or –)
We usually have ___ lunch at one o'clock. (a, an, the or –)
People should respect the nature more.
It was an unique opportunity for me.
fix: It was a unique opportunity for me.

q: I think that the money cannot buy happiness.
fix: I think that money cannot buy happiness.

q: Last year I visited the Colombia with my family.
fix: Last year I visited Colombia with my family.
e: Most country names take no article.

q: The life is hard without the friends.
e: Both nouns are general: no article.

q: She is best student in class.
a: She is the best student in the class.
She is the best student in class.

q: My father is engineer and my mother is nurse.
a: My father is an engineer and my mother is a nurse.
